title: tk tell: one-way operator announcement
description:
New cmd/tk/cmd/tell.go + registration (BOTH cobra file and the switch + usage in cmd/tk/main.go — TestLegacyDispatchCoversAllCobraCommands enforces; reset new flag vars in ResetFlags). Do NOT touch internal/operator (sibling tick owns it this wave) beyond calling existing APIs.

tk tell <text...> [--channel telegram]: load global operator config (operator.LoadOperatorConfig), build the configured channel (telegram.NewChannel), Send (plain text — transport escapes). Exit codes: 0 sent; 4 = no channel configured (documented in --help; prints one stderr line, changes nothing — prompts may call unconditionally); nonzero other for delivery failure. Read stdin when no text args (echo report | tk tell).

Test cases (fakebot via api_base in a TK_HOME config fixture): configured → message lands, HTML-special chars arrive escaped exactly once; unconfigured → exit 4, no HTTP calls; delivery 500 → nonzero, error names the channel; stdin mode.
Run: go test -short -count=1 ./cmd/tk/...
acceptance_criteria: tell tests pass incl exit-code contract (0/4/other) and no-HTTP-when-unconfigured; registered in both dispatch layers; tk --help lists tell
